svg.text: DS1 - Register a new account / Confirm the email address
A Content Manager or an Admin account is created by the platform administrator.
Look up the account by email address
[the email address is already registered and active or blocked]
Show the error message on the form
(email, full name, hashed password, disabled, role MEMBER)
Save a new verification token valid for 24 hours

Open the verification link from the inbox
Verify the email of the member (token)
Verify the email of the member
Find the token of type VERIFY_EMAIL
the token may be unknown, used or expired
(400 BAD_REQUEST "The link is invalid or has expired")
then count down to the sign-in page
then count down to the sign-in page
